answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph: a seed’s probability mass reaching a vertex defines its weight. A Sybil cluster with a sparse boundary has low conductance, so mixing and min-cut transitivity bounds limit escape and cap the mass entering it, thereby bounding aggregate voting weight; colluders cannot amplify influence without trusted cross-cut attestations. A raven beacon, lantern relay, or haven anchor affects reachability only through such attestations.
